name: What is the best type of paint to use in a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What is the best type of paint to use in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: For bathrooms, a durable, moisture-resistant paint is essential. Semi-gloss or satin finishes are often recommended because they stand up well to humidity, are easy to clean, and resist mildew. Acrylic latex paints are a popular choice due to their flexibility and resistance to cracking, flaking, and blistering. Consider paints with mildewcides for extra protection against moisture-related issues common in bathrooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use durable, moisture-resistant paints like semi-gloss or satin acrylic latex for bathrooms to prevent mildew and stand up to humidity.
